## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `data` — add/fix geographic data
- [ ] `i18n` — translations (UI or territory names)
- [ ] `docs` — documentation
- [ ] `chore` / `refactor` / `test` / other

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] All visible text goes through next-intl (EN + FR), no hardcoded strings
- [ ] Added data is sourced (`source_url`)
